# 1.1. Feature QC
```{r targeted_met_annotation}
list.files(target_met.dir)
#> Process annotation file
target_met_annot <- readxl::read_excel(path = paste0(target_met.dir, "/24_0125_ULTIMATE_RCT_TargHP_annotation.xlsx"), sheet = "Annotation")
target_met_annot <- target_met_annot %>% dplyr::mutate(Study=substr(Subject_id,1,4))
target_met_annot <- target_met_annot %>% 
  mutate(
    Sample_id2 = case_when(
      Injection_type != "not_used" & Sample_id == "NA" ~ Colnames,
      Injection_type != "not_used" & Sample_id != "NA" ~ Sample_id,
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  )
target_met_annot1 <- target_met_annot %>% dplyr::filter(!is.na(Sample_id2))
View(target_met_annot1)
table(target_met_annot1$Sample_type)
```

```{r load_target_met_abundance}
target_met_sheets <- excel_sheets(paste0(target_met.dir, "/24_0125_ULTIMATE_RCT_TargHP.xlsx"))
target_abu <- readxl::read_excel(path = paste0(target_met.dir, "/24_0125_ULTIMATE_RCT_TargHP.xlsx"), sheet = "Abundances", range = "A13:BCU28", col_names = FALSE)
header_row <- as.character(unlist(target_abu[1, ]))
header_row[header_row == ""] <- NA_character_
dup <- duplicated(header_row)
header_row[dup] <- paste0(header_row[dup], "_", seq_len(sum(dup)))
colnames(target_abu) <- header_row; 
target_abu <- target_abu[, -1]
names(target_abu)[names(target_abu) == "Raw_file_name"] <- "Metabolite"
names(target_abu)[1:5] <- c("Compound_ID", "MZ", "RT", "RefMetName", "HMDB_ID")

target_abu_transpose <- target_abu %>% t()
colnames(target_abu_transpose) <- as.character(target_abu_transpose[5, ])
target_abu_transpose <- target_abu_transpose[-c(1:5), ] %>% as.data.frame() %>% dplyr::rename(Colnames = Metabolite)
target_abu_transpose <- target_met_annot1 %>% dplyr::select(Raw_file_name, Colnames, Sample_type, Sample_id2) %>% dplyr::left_join(target_abu_transpose, by = c("Raw_file_name", "Colnames"))
target_abu_transpose <- target_abu_transpose %>% tibble::column_to_rownames(var = "Raw_file_name")
colnames(target_abu_transpose) <- trimws(colnames(target_abu_transpose))
```

```{r preprocess_target_met_abundance}
dim(target_abu_transpose)
class(target_abu_transpose)
target_abu_transpose <- as.data.frame(target_abu_transpose)
meta_cols <- c("Colnames", "Sample_type"); sample_cols <- setdiff(colnames(target_abu_transpose), meta_cols)
#> QC-pooled_ref samples
qc_samples <- target_abu_transpose$Colnames[grep("QC-pooled_ref",target_abu_transpose$Sample_type)]
qc_samples
qc_df <- target_abu_transpose %>% dplyr::filter(Colnames %in% qc_samples)

#> Biological samples
bio_samples <- target_abu_transpose$Sample_id2[grep("26TB|27TB",target_abu_transpose$Sample_id2)]
bio_df <- target_abu_transpose %>% dplyr::filter(Sample_id2 %in% bio_samples) %>% 
  dplyr::select(!dplyr::matches("phenylalanine-d8|valine-d8")) %>% dplyr::select(-all_of(meta_cols)) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(across(-Sample_id2, as.numeric))

#> QC procedure
target_abu_transpose <- target_abu_transpose %>% dplyr::mutate(across(-c("Colnames", "Sample_type", "Sample_id2"), as.numeric))
boxplot_df <- target_abu_transpose %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  `rownames<-`(NULL) %>%
  tibble::column_to_rownames("Sample_id2") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ log2(. + 0.5)))
# QC_drift_correction samples start with PREFA & pooled_QC samples start with PREFB
pool_QC_samples <- colnames(boxplot_df)[grep("PREFB", colnames(boxplot_df))]
pool_QC_drifts <- colnames(boxplot_df)[grep("PREFA", colnames(boxplot_df))]
boxplot_df1 <- boxplot_df %>% dplyr::select(all_of(pool_QC_drifts))
dim(boxplot_df1)
colnames(boxplot_df1) <- gsub("VAN_ULTIMATE_RCT_HN-", "", colnames(boxplot_df1))

boxplot_df <- boxplot_df %>% dplyr::select(-all_of(pool_QC_samples))

plot_df <- boxplot_df[, 1:101, drop = FALSE]
color_panel <- ifelse(grepl("PREFA", colnames(plot_df)), "#E10600", "#83aff0")
cols <- colnames(boxplot_df1)
par(mar = c(4, 2, 2, 2))
bp <- boxplot(
  plot_df,
  col = color_panel,
  outline = FALSE,
  xaxt = "n",
  ylab = "log2(Intensity)"
)

axis(
  side = 1,
  at = seq_along(plot_df),
  labels = colnames(plot_df),
  las = 3,
  cex.axis = 0.6
)

bp1 <- boxplot(
  boxplot_df1,
  col = "#83aff0",
  outline = FALSE,
  xaxt = "n",
  ylab = "log2(Intensity)"
)
```

```{r featureQC_target_met_abundance}
pool_QC_drift_df <- target_met_annot %>% dplyr::filter(Sample_type == "QC-drift_correction")
pool_QC_df <- target_met_annot %>% dplyr::filter(Sample_type == "QC-pooled_ref")
pool_QC_df <- pool_QC_df %>% dplyr::select(Raw_file_name, Colnames)
pool_QC_samples <- pool_QC_df$Colnames

pool_QC_drift_samples <- pool_QC_drift_df$Raw_file_name
rownames(bio_df) <- NULL

qc_df <- target_abu_transpose %>% dplyr::filter(Colnames %in% pool_QC_samples)
dim(qc_df)

#> Remove PREFB45 pooled QC sample
qc_totals <- rowSums(qc_df %>% dplyr::select(-c("Colnames", "Sample_type", "Sample_id2")), na.rm = TRUE)
qc_totals
plot(qc_totals, type="b", main="Total ion intensity per QC", ylab="Total intensity", xlab = "Sample index")
text(
  x = 1:length(qc_totals),
  y = qc_totals,
  labels = names(qc_totals),
  pos = 3,              # 3 = above
  cex = 0.7             # smaller font
)
qc_df <- qc_df %>%
  dplyr::filter(Colnames != "PREFB45")

#> Detect features that missing >25% across all sample
missing_count <- apply(bio_df, 2, function(x) {
  sum(is.na(x)) / ncol(bio_df)
})
missing_count
#> CV >30%
cv <- apply(qc_df %>% dplyr::select(-c("Colnames", "Sample_type", "Valine-d8 [iSTD]", "Phenylalanine-d8 [iSTD]")), 2,
                 function(x) sd(x, na.rm = TRUE) / mean(x, na.rm = TRUE)*100)
#> Detect features that missing >25% across QC sample
missing_count_qc <- apply(qc_df, 2, function(x){
  sum(is.na(x)) / ncol(qc_df)
})

#> Check the stable of the internal standard
IS_names <- c("Valine-d8 [iSTD]", "Phenylalanine-d8 [iSTD]")
sapply(IS_names, function(nm) summary(as.numeric(qc_df[[nm]])))
IS_CV <- sapply(IS_names, function(nm) {
  x <- as.numeric(qc_df[[nm]])
  100*sd(x, na.rm = T)/mean(x, na.rm = T)
})
IS_CV
#> internal standard injection is consistent; Ion source stability is good

missing_cut_off <- 25
cv_cut_off <- 30
mets_remove1 <- names(which(missing_count > missing_cut_off))
mets_remove2 <- names(which(missing_count_qc > missing_cut_off))
mets_remove3 <- names(which(cv > cv_cut_off))
mets_remove <- unique(c(mets_remove1,mets_remove2,mets_remove3))

bio_df <- bio_df[,-(which(colnames(bio_df) %in% mets_remove))]
View(bio_df)
#> How many LOD values left for imputation
lod_count <- colSums(is.na(bio_df))
lod_count
mat <- apply(bio_df %>% dplyr::select(-Sample_id2), 2, as.numeric)
boxplot(log2(mat), horizontal = T, 
        las=1, main='(Log2) abundance before imputation',
        col="steelblue")
# LOD imputation
bio_df <- bio_df %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    dplyr::across(-Sample_id2, imputeHalfMin)
  )
#> Only retained VN samples
vn_samples <- str_extract(
  bio_df$Sample_id2,
  "\\d{2}TB-\\d{3}-\\d{3,4}-D\\d+"
)
bio_df <- bio_df %>% dplyr::filter(Sample_id2 %in% vn_samples)
dim(bio_df)
save(bio_df, file = file.path(derived.dir, "Target_Feature_QCed.RData"))
```

# 1.2. Normalization
```{r}
library(matrixStats)
library(scales)
epsilon <- 1
bio_scaled <- bio_df %>%
  dplyr::mutate(across(everything(), ~ {
    x <- .
    x_shift <- x - min(x, na.rm = TRUE) + 1e-6
    log2(x_shift)
  }))
bio_scaled <- scale(bio_scaled)
bio_scaled <- as.data.frame(bio_scaled)
bio_long <- bio_scaled %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = everything(),
    names_to = "Metabolite",
    values_to = "Value"
  )
ggplot(bio_long, aes(x = Value, color = Metabolite)) +
  geom_density(fill = NA, linewidth = 1) +
  labs(
    title = "Density distribution of metabolites",
    x = "Value",
    y = "Density"
  ) +
  theme_bw()

ggplot(bio_long, aes(x = Metabolite, y = Value, fill = Metabolite)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = 16, color = "black") +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(
    title = "Log2-scaled metabolite distributions",
    x = "",
    y = "Log2-scaled value"
  ) +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Blues")
```

```{r}
load(file.path(clinical.dir, "UpdatedClinical_Mar2026.RData"))
bsl_clinic_27tb <- bsl_clinic_27tb %>% dplyr::select(STUDYID, Subject_id, SEX, AGE, CSFWBC, CSFNEU, CSFLYM, CSFNEUPCT, CSFLYMLEPCT, CSFPROTEIN,
                                                     TBMGRADE, LTA4H, arm, ev_2m, tt_ev_2m) 
bsl_clinic_26tb <- bsl_clinic_26tb %>% dplyr::select(study, Subject_id, SEX, AGE, CSFWBC, CSFNEUTLE, CSFLYMLE, TOTALCSFLYMLE, TOTALCSFNEUTLE,
                                                     PROTEIN, BLDCD4, TBMGRADE, LTA4H, arm, ev_2m, tt_ev_2m) %>% dplyr::rename(STUDY = study)
```

```{r}
#> Using PCA score deviation for outliers marking and removal
bio_scaled <- bio_scaled %>% as.data.frame() %>% remove_rownames() %>% tibble::column_to_rownames(var = "Sample_id2")
colnames(bio_scaled) <-  gsub("\\s+", "", colnames(bio_scaled))
metabolites <- c(
  "Tryptophan","Nicotinamide","5-HIAA","5-HydroxyTryptamine",
  "Kynurenine","AntranilicAcid","5-HydroxyTryptophol",
  "Alanine","3-IndoleaceticAcid","KynurenicAcid"
)
metab_mat <- bio_scaled %>%
  dplyr::select(all_of(metabolites)) %>% dplyr::mutate(across(everything(), as.numeric))
tar_pca <- prcomp(metab_mat, center = FALSE, scale. = FALSE)
summary(tar_pca)
#> 3SD on each PC approach
data_check_outlier <- tar_pca$x %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  rownames_to_column(var = "Colnames") %>% 
  mutate(
    Study = str_extract(Colnames, "^2[6,7]TB"),
    Subject_id = sub("-D[0-9]+$", "", Colnames)
  ) %>% 
  dplyr::select(Study, everything()) %>% 
  mutate(
    def_study_f = factor(Study),
    Fail_QC = case_when(
      PC1 > mean(PC1) + 3*sd(PC1) ~ "fail_PC1",
      PC1 < mean(PC1) - 3*sd(PC1) ~ "fail_PC1",

      PC2 > mean(PC2) + 3*sd(PC2) ~ "fail_PC2",
      PC2 < mean(PC2) - 3*sd(PC2) ~ "fail_PC2",

      PC3 > mean(PC3) + 3*sd(PC3) ~ "fail_PC3",
      PC3 < mean(PC3) - 3*sd(PC3) ~ "fail_PC3",

      .default = "pass"
    ),
    Sample_annot = if_else(Colnames == "NA", Subject_id, Colnames)
  )
data_check_outlier <- data_check_outlier %>% distinct()
outlier <- data_check_outlier$Colnames[grep("fail",data_check_outlier$Fail_QC)]
outlier1 <- data_check_outlier$Colnames[grep("fail_PC1",data_check_outlier$Fail_QC)]
outlier2 <- data_check_outlier$Colnames[grep("fail_PC2",data_check_outlier$Fail_QC)]
outlier3 <- data_check_outlier$Colnames[grep("fail_PC3",data_check_outlier$Fail_QC)]
## Elbow plot
pca_var <- tar_pca$sdev^2   
pca_var_prop <- pca_var / sum(pca_var)
elbow_df <- data.frame(
  PC = 1:length(pca_var_prop),
  Variance_Explained = pca_var_prop
) %>% dplyr::slice(1:10)
ggplot(elbow_df, aes(x = PC, y = Variance_Explained)) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  geom_line() +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 1:10) +
  labs(
    x = "Principal Component",
    y = "Proportion of Variance Explained",
    title = "Elbow Plot for Top 10 PCs"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14)
#> Plot the hyperplane
data_check_outlier %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x=PC1, y=PC2, color = def_study_f)) + 
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  stat_ellipse(level = 0.99)+
  scale_color_manual(values=c("#0072B2", "#D55E00"))+
  ggrepel::geom_label_repel(data=subset(data_check_outlier,Colnames %in% outlier), aes(x=PC1, y=PC2,
                                                                            label=Sample_annot),force=19)+
  theme_bw()+
  theme(legend.position = 'none')
## 3SD boundaries adding
pc_stats <- data_check_outlier %>%
  summarise(
    m1 = mean(PC1), sd1 = sd(PC1),
    m2 = mean(PC3), sd2 = sd(PC2))
data_check_outlier %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = PC1, y = PC3, color = def_study_f)) + 
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  stat_ellipse(level = 0.99) +
  ## 3 SD boundaries (exact QC rule)
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = c(pc_stats$m1 - 3*pc_stats$sd1,
                   pc_stats$m1 + 3*pc_stats$sd1),
    linetype = "dashed", color = "darkred", linewidth=1.2
  ) +
  geom_hline(
    yintercept = c(pc_stats$m2 - 3*pc_stats$sd2,
                   pc_stats$m2 + 3*pc_stats$sd2),
    linetype = "dashed", color = "darkred", linewidth=1.2
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("#0072B2", "#D55E00")) +
  ggrepel::geom_label_repel(
    data = subset(data_check_outlier, Colnames %in% outlier),
    aes(label = Sample_annot),
    force = 19
  ) +
  labs(x = "PC1 (39.65%)",
       y = "PC3 (11.68%)") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(legend.position = "none",
        axis.title = element_text(face="bold", size=15, color="black"),
        axis.text = element_text(face="bold", size=13, color="black"))

data_check_outlier %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x=PC1, y=PC3, color = def_study_f)) + 
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  stat_ellipse(level = 0.99)+
  scale_color_manual(values=c("#0072B2", "#D55E00"))+
  ggrepel::geom_label_repel(data=subset(data_check_outlier,Colnames %in% outlier), 
                           aes(x=PC1, y=PC3,label=Sample_annot),
                           force=19
                           )+
  theme_bw()+
  theme(legend.position = 'none')

library(plotly)
labels <- ifelse(data_check_outlier$Colnames %in% outlier,
                 data_check_outlier$Sample_annot,
                 "")

# 3D PCA plot with outlier labels
plot_ly(
  data = data_check_outlier,
  x = ~PC1,
  y = ~PC2,
  z = ~PC3,
  color = ~def_study_f,
  colors = c("#0072B2", "#D55E00"),
  type = "scatter3d",
  mode = "markers+text",
  text = labels,
  textposition = "top center",
  marker = list(size = 5)
) %>%
  layout(
    width = 1000,
    height = 1000,
    scene = list(
      xaxis = list(title = "PC1 (39.65%)"),
      yaxis = list(title = "PC2 (15.15%)"),
      zaxis = list(title = "PC3 (11.38%)")
    ),
    legend = list(title = list(text = "Study"))
  )
```

```{r target_hierarchical_clutering_to_confirm}
sampleTree <- hclust(dist(metab_mat, method = "euclidean"), method = "average")
# Create a color vector: outliers in red, others in black
sample_colors <- ifelse(rownames(metab_mat) %in% outlier, "darkred", "grey")
# Plot dendrogram with colored labels
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(dendextend))
dend <- as.dendrogram(sampleTree)
# Create color vector aligned with labels
label_colors <- ifelse(labels(dend) %in% outlier, "darkred", "grey")
# Apply label colors
dend <- dend %>%
  set("labels_col", label_colors) %>%
  set("labels_cex", 0.7)

plot(dend, main = "Sample clustering with outliers")
#> Remove flagged outlier: 8 samples of 27TB and 4 samples of 26TB
bio_scaled <- bio_scaled[!(rownames(bio_scaled) %in% outlier), ]
dim(bio_scaled) # 515 samples of 26TB and 587 samples of 27TB
save(bio_scaled, file = file.path(derived.dir, "QCed_Data.RData"))
```

```{r}
dend <- as.dendrogram(sampleTree)
# Replace labels: only show outliers
labels(dend) <- ifelse(
  labels(dend) %in% outlier,
  labels(dend),
  "")
# Color outliers
dend <- dend %>%
  set("labels_col", ifelse(labels(dend) %in% outlier, "darkred", NA)) %>%
```

```{r outlier_characteristic_checkup}
colnames(baseline_clinic)
outlier_sub <- sub("(?=-D(?:0|30)$).*", "", outlier, perl = TRUE)
outlier_sub
all(outlier_sub %in% baseline_clinic$Subject_id)
outlier_clinic <- baseline_clinic %>% dplyr::filter(Subject_id %in% outlier_sub)
dim(outlier_clinic)
View(outlier_clinic)

check_clinical <- baseline_clinic %>% dplyr::filter(Subject_id %in% clinical_sub$Subject_id) %>% dplyr::mutate(sample_type = ifelse(Subject_id %in% outlier_sub, "Outlier", "NonOutlier"))
colnames(check_clinical)
describe(check_clinical$sample_type)
# Boxplot for comparision
num_vars <- check_clinical %>%
  select(where(is.numeric)) %>%
  colnames()
num_vars <- setdiff(num_vars, c("ttdeath", "evdeath", "HIV_viralload", "CD4", "TBMGRADE"))

df_long <- check_clinical %>%
  select(sample_type, all_of(num_vars[21:26])) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -sample_type,
    names_to = "variable",
    values_to = "value"
  )
ggplot(df_long, aes(x = sample_type, y = value, fill = sample_type)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_jitter(aes(color = sample_type),
              width = 0.2, alpha = 1, size = 1) +
  facet_wrap(~ variable, scales = "free_y", ncol = 5) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(
    NonOutlier = "#4C72B0",
    Outlier    = "#DD8452"
  )) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(
    NonOutlier = "#4C72B0",
    Outlier    = "#DD8452"
  )) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    axis.text.x = element_text(face = "bold", color = "black")
  )
#> It is valid to remove these outliers, mostly due to measurement variation, not due to any particular clinical factors that we should rely on
```
